# Drift

Drift is an AI copilot CLI for robotics simulation. Users describe what they want in plain English at the `drift>` prompt. Drift generates URDF/SDF robot descriptions, ROS2 package structures, Gazebo world files, and launch files — then builds the workspace with colcon and manages all simulation processes. No manual config files required.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://godrift.ai/install | bash`
Start: `drift` (in any terminal on Ubuntu)
Status: open beta. For the current version, see https://github.com/godrift-ai/drift-releases/releases (or run `/version`). No version is pinned here on purpose — a hardcoded number goes stale the moment a release ships.
Website: https://godrift.ai
Docs: https://docs.godrift.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/godrift-ai/drift-releases

---

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.godrift.ai/getting-started/introduction): Drift is your AI copilot for building, testing, and debugging robot simulations. Just come with prompts — we handle the rest.
- [Installation](https://docs.godrift.ai/getting-started/installation): System requirements and how to install Drift CLI
- [Quickstart](https://docs.godrift.ai/getting-started/quickstart): Go from zero to a running robotics simulation in under 5 minutes
- [FAQ](https://docs.godrift.ai/getting-started/faq): Common questions about Drift CLI
- [Support](https://docs.godrift.ai/getting-started/support): Get help with Drift - reach the team by email or connect with the community on Discord.

## Guides

- [Your First Simulation](https://docs.godrift.ai/guides/first-simulation): A complete walkthrough to build a pick-and-place robot simulation and launch on Gazebo from scratch with Drift
- [Build manipulator arm in RViz](https://docs.godrift.ai/guides/manipulator-rviz): Build a manipulator arm simulation and inspect it live in RViz in one prompt
- [Building a MuJoCo Scene](https://docs.godrift.ai/guides/mujoco-scene): Author an MJCF scene, run a headless simulation, and inspect the result — all from prompts
- [Project Context (DRIFT.md)](https://docs.godrift.ai/guides/project-context): Teach Drift your project once with a DRIFT.md so you stop re-explaining it on every command
- [Custom Skills](https://docs.godrift.ai/guides/skills): Drop your team's procedures into a markdown file. Drift picks them up and uses them.

## Robot Showcase

- [Quadruped — Unitree Go2](https://docs.godrift.ai/showcase/quadruped-go2): Set up a Unitree Go2 standing demo on a stairs scene in one prompt
- [Dual-arm — Trossen Aloha](https://docs.godrift.ai/showcase/dual-arm-aloha): Set up an Aloha bimanual rig on a tabletop and reach both arms toward objects in one prompt
- [Humanoid — Unitree H1](https://docs.godrift.ai/showcase/humanoid-h1): Set up a Unitree H1 humanoid holding a balanced standing pose on flat ground
